chief_complaint: Acute chest pain and respiratory distress

key_rationale.Needle thoracostomy: Immediate decompression is life-saving when tension pneumothorax is discovered on exam
key_rationale.Chest tube insertion: Definitive treatment for lung reexpansion after needle decompression
key_rationale.Chest x-ray after intervention: Confirms appropriate tube placement and lung reexpansion
key_rationale.Avoid delays: Any testing that delays treatment (ECG, ABG) can be harmful or fatal

correct_orders: Rheumatoid factor OR Anti-CCP antibody test
Arthrocentesis with synovial fluid studies (cell count, crystals, culture)
Exercise counseling or physical/occupational therapy referral
should_avoid_orders: Treatment with NSAIDs or corticosteroids alone

key_rationale.DMARD therapy: Prevents or slows joint damage, essential for comprehensive treatment
key_rationale.NSAIDs/corticosteroids plus DMARD: Combination addresses both symptom relief and disease modification
key_rationale.Avoid NSAIDs alone: Does not prevent joint damage or modify disease course

correct_orders: IV beta-blocker (to lower BP and HR)
Cardiac monitoring or repeat vital signs
CT chest with contrast OR Cardiac CTA with contrast OR Echocardiogram OR TEE OR MRI chest OR Cardiac MRI with gadolinium
Open heart surgery OR EVAR OR Thoracotomy/cardiothoracic surgery OR General surgery consult
Serum creatinine (basic or complete metabolic panel)

key_rationale.IV beta-blocker: Lowers blood pressure and heart rate to stabilize dissection
key_rationale.Surgical intervention: Ascending aortic dissection with aortic root involvement requires emergency surgery
key_rationale.Avoid thrombolytics: Contraindicated in aortic dissection, can be fatal

correct_orders: Inhalation bronchodilator (albuterol or levalbuterol with ipratropium)
Asthma counseling and medication side effects education
should_avoid_orders: Bronchodilator by non-inhalation route (IM or oral)
Arterial blood gas analysis for monitoring

key_rationale.Inhalation bronchodilator: Most effective route for acute asthma treatment in children
key_rationale.Oral steroid: Reduces airway inflammation in acute asthma exacerbation
key_rationale.Repeat chest exam: Monitors response to treatment without invasive testing

condition: Diabetic Ketoacidosis with E. coli Sepsis
correct_orders: Isotonic IV fluids (Lactated Ringer or normal saline)
Repeat vital signs OR admission to inpatient/ICU
Serum beta-hydroxybutyrate or urinalysis for ketones
Continued monitoring of glucose, electrolytes (especially potassium), and arterial pH
should_avoid_orders: IV fluids other than isotonic (hypotonic saline or dextrose in water)

key_rationale.Isotonic IV fluids: Corrects severe dehydration in DKA; hypotonic solutions are inappropriate
key_rationale.IV insulin: Required for acute hyperglycemia management in DKA, not subcutaneous
key_rationale.Electrolyte monitoring: Potassium shifts during DKA treatment require close monitoring

chief_complaint: Seizure and loss of consciousness (38 weeks pregnant)
correct_orders: IV hydralazine OR IV labetalol OR PO nifedipine
Delivery (stimulate contractions with uterotonics OR cesarean delivery OR OB/GYN consult)
Serum creatinine or BUN (basic or comprehensive metabolic panel)
should_avoid_orders: Peripheral blood smear instead of CBC
IM or IV phenobarbital or benzodiazepine instead of magnesium sulfate

key_rationale.IV magnesium sulfate: Prevents recurrent seizures in eclampsia, superior to benzodiazepines
key_rationale.Delivery: Definitive treatment for eclampsia at 38 weeks gestation
key_rationale.CBC and platelets: Rules out HELLP syndrome and hemolysis
